# Author Vista

> Author Vista is an end-to-end publishing-services and assisted self-publishing partner for authors in the United States, United Kingdom and beyond.

## Core facts

- Author Vista is not a traditional publisher.
- Authors retain copyright, publishing-account control where platforms permit, and royalties.
- Services are intended to cover manuscript development, editing, book design, publishing assistance, audiobook production and author marketing.
- Projects are quoted individually.
- No sales, ranking, bestseller, review or media outcomes are guaranteed.

## Primary pages

- /: company overview and author stage routing
- /services/: publishing services overview
- /how-it-works/: project process
- /ownership-and-publishing-control/: rights, royalties and account control
- /frequently-asked-questions/: visible buyer questions and answers

## Preview status

The current site is a non-indexable preview. Legal identity, contact details, portfolio, testimonials and verified credentials remain pending and must not be inferred.
